say:1:1035824001:0.text: Who wouldn't want that? Unfortunately, history is not up to us to decide.
say:1:1035824001:0.source_cn: 谁不是这样想的呢？可惜历史不是我们说了算的。
say:1:1035824001:0.male: Who wouldn't want that? Unfortunately, history is not up to us to decide.
say:1:1035824001:0.female: Who wouldn't want that? Unfortunately, history is not up to us to decide.

say:2:1035824002:1.text: For someone like me who can't use magic, I worry that just looking at a Hypogean will turn me to dust.
say:2:1035824002:1.source_cn: 像我这种没能掌握魔法的人，恐怕多看那恶魔一眼都会直接蒸发。
say:2:1035824002:1.male: For someone like me who can't use magic, I worry that just looking at a Hypogean will turn me to dust.
say:2:1035824002:1.female: For someone like me who can't use magic, I worry that just looking at a Hypogean will turn me to dust.

say:3:1035824003:1.text: I also have no desire to see any gods or celestials either.
say:3:1035824003:1.source_cn: 而且我也不太想真的见到神明或者半神。
say:3:1035824003:1.male: I also have no desire to see any gods or celestials either.
say:3:1035824003:1.female: I also have no desire to see any gods or celestials either.

say:4:1035824004:1.text: What if they don't look as divine as I've imagined them? No, I'd rather preserve my image of them.
say:4:1035824004:1.source_cn: 万一他们长得不如我想象中神圣，该怎么办？还是保留点幻想吧。
say:4:1035824004:1.male: What if they don't look as divine as I've imagined them? No, I'd rather preserve my image of them.
say:4:1035824004:1.female: What if they don't look as divine as I've imagined them? No, I'd rather preserve my image of them.
